Warm-up · Ch. 1 + algebra

Algebra & trig warm-up

The precalculus skills every calculus problem leans on. Most points lost on exams are algebra slips, not calculus, so fix these first.

0 / 16 problems mastered

Start here. Do these 16 before touching anything else. Each one is a move you will make inside a bigger calculus problem: factoring inside a limit, exponent rules before the power rule, log rules before log differentiation, unit-circle values in every trig problem. If one takes you more than 3 minutes, open its walkthrough and redo it tomorrow.

Traps

Fake distributing

(a+b)2≠a2+b2(a+b)^2\ne a^2+b^2(a+b)2=a2+b2, a+b≠a+b\sqrt{a+b}\ne\sqrt a+\sqrt ba+b​=a​+b​, ln⁡(a+b)≠ln⁡a+ln⁡b\ln(a+b)\ne\ln a+\ln bln(a+b)=lna+lnb. These cost more points than any calculus rule.

Cancel factors, not terms

x2+3x\frac{x^2+3}{x}xx2+3​ does not simplify to x+3x+3x+3. Only something multiplied by everything on top can cancel.

sin⁻¹x is not 1/sin x

sin⁡−1x=arcsin⁡x\sin^{-1}x=\arcsin xsin−1x=arcsinx. The reciprocal is csc⁡x\csc xcscx.

Dividing by a variable

Dividing both sides by xxx loses the solution x=0x=0x=0. Factor instead: x2=3x⇒x(x−3)=0x^2=3x\Rightarrow x(x-3)=0x2=3x⇒x(x−3)=0.
